usedFor: Shopify spots the abandoned checkout and WhatsApp reaches the shopper when “Abandoned Checkout” runs “Send WhatsApp Message”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Send WhatsApp Message” in WhatsApp
bestTemplate.why: The trigger captures the shopper's email or phone, and the message goes out through your WhatsApp account.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify is polling, so a nudge follows a scheduled check, not the moment of leaving.
